correctness.rationale: Exact positivity and total-mass evolution confine all invariant probabilities to the origin and unit-mass face. On the face, AM–GM forces species-product strict loss except at coexistence and zero-coordinate boundaries. Edge scalar drift has a uniform strict sign, eliminating edge stationary mass; only five fixed atoms remain. At alpha=1 every face point is fixed. Normalized-product descent proves extinction-boundary approach without asserting individual-species convergence. Sympy symbolic identities and 132 exact rational cases in the standalone checker agree, but the infinite theorem relies on the analytical argument.

value.rationale: The critical interaction balance supports a continuous-time continuum of periodic May–Leonard trajectories. Proving that every positive forward-Euler step instead has only five ergodic stationary states, and that all unequal positive compositions approach a boundary, provides a natural complete global statistical classification. The exceptional alpha=beta=1 point has a sharply different infinite-dimensional stationary measure simplex. No generic paper-sized claim is needed to make this exact natural invariant valuable.
